# ZurfurGui

> ZurfurGui is a minimal, inheritance-free C# GUI framework for WebAssembly and Windows desktop,
> using HTML5 Canvas and native drawing APIs.

## Getting Started and Usage

- [Project overview](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/gosub-com/ZurfurGui/main/README.md): Project
  introduction and usage information.
- [Architecture](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/gosub-com/ZurfurGui/main/docs/architecture.md):
  Framework structure and design principles.
- [ZUI format](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/gosub-com/ZurfurGui/main/docs/zui-format.md):
  Declarative UI file format.
- [Property binding](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/gosub-com/ZurfurGui/main/docs/property-binding.md):
  Data bindings and view properties.
- [Styles and themes](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/gosub-com/ZurfurGui/main/docs/styles-and-themes.md):
  Styling and theme tokens.

## Input and Interaction
- [Input events](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/gosub-com/ZurfurGui/main/docs/input-events.md):
  Pointer and wheel event behavior.
- [Gesture recognizers](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/gosub-com/ZurfurGui/main/docs/gesture-recognizer.md):
  Click, pan, and custom gesture behavior.

## Controls

- [Controls](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/gosub-com/ZurfurGui/main/docs/controls.md):
  Application setup and built-in controls.
- [List box](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/gosub-com/ZurfurGui/main/docs/list-box.md):
  ListBox usage and behavior.
- [Combo box](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/gosub-com/ZurfurGui/main/docs/combo-box.md):
  ComboBox usage and behavior.
- [Tree view](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/gosub-com/ZurfurGui/main/docs/tree-view.md):
  TreeView usage and behavior.
- [Scroll viewer](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/gosub-com/ZurfurGui/main/docs/scroll-viewer.md):
  Scrollable content and viewer behavior.

## Setup and Reference

- [Initialization](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/gosub-com/ZurfurGui/main/docs/initialization.md):
  Application startup and control registration.
- [Code generation](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/gosub-com/ZurfurGui/main/docs/code-generation.md):
  Source generator behavior and generated outputs.
